newsitem.title: USA: Fed refrains from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed refrains from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve refrained from open market operations on Monday, dealers said.
The Fed's absence in the market surprised some economists on Wall Street, who expected the Fed to add reserves through customer repurchase agreements.
At 1130 EDT/1530 GMT, the time the Fed usually intervenes in the market, the federal funds rate was quoted at 5-3/16 percent, below the central bank's 5-1/4 percent target.
